notes.title: Patch 0.2.1.3
notes.content:
Hey there, brave detectives!

Patch 0.2.1.3 is here, and with it a lot of style. Steam Next Fest begins today, and we thought the game could use some more polish in order for you to immerse in its atmosphere even more. Broadly speaking, you'll find:
[list]
[*] New animations: for our regular dialogues outside of interrogations, as well as background characters. For example, some folks now run from the rain, while others keep their cool thanks to their handy umbrellas!

[*] Sound: we managed to give proper attention to sound work in these past weeks. Some bugs related to that are fixed, and some characters have new music.

[*] General stability: we fixed a load of bugs, typos and dialogues, so the overall experience is considerably smoother now.
[/list]
If you already played the previous version, you'll have fun checking out our character's new facial expressions, and their new music. If you haven't, this is the moment, as we're really proud of what we achieved.

In case you encounter any issue at all, make a post in our Community Hub and we'll help you solve it.

Good luck on your posthumous investigation!

-- Victor

notes.title: The Posthumous Investigation Developer Playthrough
notes.content:
[h3]Hello, fellow detectives![/h3]

We at Mother Gaia Studio have been working hard at The Posthumous Investigation for the past 3-ish years, and we're very excited to put the game in your hands.

But before that special day comes, we wanted to show you how the game is shaping up, and decided to mark our participation in Steam's Visual Novel Fest by trying to broadcast a pre-alpha playthrough. In it, Victor ([i]me![/i]) walks through the first loop of the game while explaining the core mechanics, main inspirations, and even stumbling upon some bugs!

Come watch it to have a deeper look into our game. Or just take a glance if you don't want spoilers. It's all support, and all appreciated!

The broadcast will be streaming 24/7 during all of Visual Novel Fest, but we won't be live in chat. If you want to get in touch to ask any questions, you can comment on this post or contact us through our website and social media, and we'll get back as soon as possible.
And if all goes well, we'll also be setting up our Steam Community Hub sometime soon.

Thank you, and see you soon!

-- Victor
